title: 墨镜风衣
prompt: Use case: photorealistic high-end international fashion magazine editorial (Vogue / Harper's Bazaar style) pet portrait, shot by a top fashion photographer in a professional indoor studio. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not a pose or background template. Keep the same adult seal-point Siamese cat from Image 1, with cream body, dark seal-brown points and sapphire-blue eyes. One pet only, no people. Wear exactly the garments and accessories named in the set description, tailored and clearly visible; nothing else. Set and light: A chic fashion magazine portrait against a saturated cobalt-blue seamless backdrop, with the curved back of a white bentwood chair visible beside the cat. Half-body framing from head to chest. The cat sits upright with its head slightly tilted down, gazing over the top of the sunglasses at the camera with a confident, knowing look. The cat clearly wears tortoiseshell sunglasses on its face, resting low on its nose, and a camel trench coat with the collar popped up. Crisp editorial light, clean graphic shadow. The cat sits upright, head tilted slightly down, gazing over the top of the sunglasses it is wearing. Photographic qualities: a single dominant light source with one consistent direction, natural soft falloff into shadow, true-to-life fur with individual strands and slight natural unevenness, realistic eye moisture with one small catchlight, believable contact shadow where the body meets the surface. Camera: medium-format fashion camera with a 100mm lens at about f/4, eye-level, crisp detail on the face and coat. Controlled professional studio lighting, refined color grading like a printed magazine spread, deep clean tones, no HDR look, no plastic retouching. Attitude matters most: handsome, noble and commanding like a top fashion model on a magazine cover, with a strong pose and a cool, self-assured, slightly aloof expression, so that any pet owner would want this cover shot of their own pet. Indoor studio only, never outdoors, never a wide landscape. Vertical 3:4 half-body portrait from head to chest, the pet large in frame, with one or two real set pieces partly visible beside it so the backdrop is not empty. Avoid: outdoor scenery, nature backgrounds, messy cluttered sets, full-body tiny pet, cute or goofy expressions, dull muddy tones, blank or sleepy expression, human-like poses, cartoonish costumes, hats, multiple accessories, glowing or rim light that looks painted, dramatic fantasy lighting, oversaturated colors, plastic or airbrushed fur, perfect symmetry, extra props, floating body, pasted edges, extra limbs, duplicate pets, CGI or illustration look, text, logos or watermark. Return one photograph only.
